identity.name: Rohan Kapoor
identity.headline: Driving Digital Transformation, Enterprise Scale & AI Adoption
identity.shortBio: Rohan Kapoor is a business transformation and technology leader with over 16 years of experience across India and the Middle East. He works with organisations on digital transformation, enterprise technology, AI adoption and business strategy.
identity.longBio: I believe technology should solve real business problems rather than simply introduce more technology. My work focuses on connecting business strategy, people and technology to create sustainable transformation.
